claims.text: The hotel is on the Suhe Creek waterfront and forms part of the SUHE CREEK project, a riverside urban revitalization.

findings.quote: Located on the Suhe Creek waterfront, Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai forms part of the SUHE CREEK project, a riverside urban revitalization

claims.text: The property combines a 48-storey tower with the restored former Chamber of Commerce Shanghai building dating from 1916.

findings.quote: the property combines a 48-storey tower with the majestically restored former Chamber of Commerce Shanghai building dating from 1916

claims.text: The hotel is on the banks of Suzhou Creek, just minutes from the Bund.

findings.quote: Suzhou Creek, just minutes from the iconic Bund

claims.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito is on the 47th floor of the hotel.

findings.quote: celebrates the rich heritage of Italy from the pinnacle 47th floor of The Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai

claims.text: The Bvlgari Bar shares the 47th floor with Il Ristorante - Niko Romito.

findings.quote: Sharing the 47th floor with Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, The Bvlgari Bar shimmers like a jewel

claims.text: Bao Li Xuan is the hotel's Chinese restaurant specializing in Guangdong cuisine.

findings.quote: Bao Li Xuan, the Chinese restaurant specializing in Guangdong cuisine

claims.text: The Bvlgari Spa uses La Mer products and offers rituals inspired by traditional Chinese medicine.

findings.quote: La Mer products, alongside rituals inspired by traditional Chinese medicine

claims.text: La Terrazza has teak decking, ivory-cushioned armchairs and curtained cabanas.

findings.quote: an urban oasis featuring teak decking, ivory-cushioned armchairs and curtained cabanas for a discreet escape

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler names Antonio Citterio and Patricia Viel as behind the Bulgari-hotel aesthetic.

findings.quote: tailor the typically hard-edged, dark, woody, and rather masculine Bulgari-hotel aesthetic (Antonio Citterio and Patricia Viel once again) accordingly

claims.text: The hotel has an Italian garden, Il Giardino, in front of the Lounge, available for private parties and events.

findings.quote: In front of the Lounge, the Italian garden is also available for private parties and events.

claims.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito was awarded one Michelin star by The Michelin Guide Shanghai for 6 consecutive years since 2019.

findings.quote: Il Ristorante – Niko Romito was awarded one Michelin star by The Michelin Guide Shanghai for 6 consecutive years since 2019.

claims.text: The Bvlgari Bar's oval counter in Shanghai is made from hand-hammered bronze topped with mirrored steel.

findings.quote: For Shanghai, the bar was made from hand-hammered bronze topped with mirrored steel

claims.text: The centrepiece of the spa is an indoor heated swimming pool surrounded by columns recalling a Roman bath.

findings.quote: The centrepiece of the Spa is a 25-metre indoor heated swimming pool, surrounded by statuesque columns recalling the grandeur of a Roman bath.

claims.text: At sunset hours, every drink ordered at The Bvlgari Bar is paired with fresh canapes, at the oval bar or on the outdoor terrace.

findings.quote: At sunset hours, every drink ordered is paired with fresh canapés, enjoyed either at the oval bar or on the outdoor terrace overlooking the river.

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes that, because of the building's shape and orientation, a few rooms have disappointing views, and advises asking for a room with a view across the Huangpu River to Pudong.

findings.quote: Because of the shape and orientation of the building, however, there are a few duds. So be sure to ask for a room with a view across the Huangpu River to Pudong.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive brand positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited availability due to the boutique size of the hotel.
